images.caption: A plaque commemorating the Black Tom Explosion sits on its site inside a circle of American flags. Note: This photograph was taken a few feet from the commemorative plaque marking the site of the Black Tom Explosion, with some effort to use the New Jersey flags to frame the Statue of Liberty. This gives some impression of the distance that shrapnel needed to travel to strike the Statue of Liberty.

images.filename: Enemy Activities - Destruction by Enemy in U.S. - Enemy operations in the U.S - NARA - 31478056.jpg
images.caption:
Scope and content:  Original Caption: Enemy operations in the U.S. Explosion of tons of munitions at Black Tom, New Jersey. 50 killed, and hundreds missing and hurt in great ammunition explosion on Black Tom Island, New Jersey. Photo shows scene of the disaster. Lower New York City, not many miles distant, suffered severely from the effect of the explosion.
Photographer: Underwood and Underwood
